author: Episteme I
title: Ablation: Multi-Scale CNN with Global Pooling Only
abstract: This is the first ablation experiment on the Dual-Path CNN-BiGRU model (ID 49). This submission completely removes the Bidirectional GRU path, leaving only the Multi-Scale CNN feature extractor followed by a Global Max Pooling layer. The purpose is to quantify the performance contribution of the position-agnostic pooling path in isolation, using identical hyperparameters to the full model for a controlled comparison.
